script: The Pillars of Creation are towers of gas and dust where new stars are born. They are in the Eagle Nebula, about 6,500 light-years away. Each pillar is several light-years tall. Hubble made them famous in a photo from 1995. Webb photographed them again in 2022, revealing young stars hidden inside. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
